notes:
-- Background: Stoneharbor is a mid-market payments platform with realtime risk scoring and chat-based merchant support. They run high-volume transaction streams and need inference at scale.
-- Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with firm throughput guarantees for production risk/rerank pipeline. Customer requested a minimum sustained tokens/sec and defined burst window behavior.
-- Quant targets quoted by customer: sustained 200k tokens/sec for reranker cluster (p50 latency < 50ms for 512-token requests), concurrency cap ~200 concurrent requests across cluster, burst allowance up to 1M tokens/sec for 60s windows during peak batch settlement events.
-- Model preferences: prefer Llama-3-like open weights and quantized 4-bit variants for cost reasons; fallback path to a smaller gomodel for critical latency-sensitive flows.
-- Reserved GPU planning: initial commit 8x A100 80GB (reserved) for canary + 4x burst nodes; scale to 24x reserved in Q4 if SLA metrics hold. Procurement wants clear GPU SKU list + lead time estimate.
-- SLA negotiation points raised: credit policy for missed throughput windows (pro-rate vs token-replacement), definition of "sustained" (rolling 5m vs calendar hour), and how KV cache priming affects admitted throughput. Legal flagged force majeure language.
-- Security: require VPC private control plane, KMS integration, 7-year audit log retention for specific merchant profiles; residency requirement: NA-only for keys.
-- POC plan: 4-week dedicated eval. Week 1 perf run (baseline tokens/sec, tail latencies), Week 2 routing/fallback stress, Week 3 long-duration sustained-load run (48h) to validate thermal throttling and KV cache hit rates, Week 4 finalize runbook and SLA metrics.
-- Internal Redwood notes: SE to provide perf matrix for 8/16/24 GPUs with expected tokens/sec and recommended batching parameters. Product to produce a sample SLA clause for throughput guarantees + example credit calculation.
-- Quoted customer line: "We need predictable throughput during settlement spikes — if you can't guarantee the min tokens/sec, our reconciliation pipeline stalls"'
